Sao Paulo.uid: IBGE CD2022 census-sector key (may be prefixed by city)
Sao Paulo.lat/lon: Author-calculated EPSG:4326 Shapely representative point of source CD2022 sector, not a centroid or GHSL grid centre
Sao Paulo.pop: IBGE 2022 V0001 whole source-tract total persons; no areal apportionment
Sao Paulo.stratum/socioeconomic_group: Author quintile classification from IBGE V06004; source is responsible-person mean income, not household-total or per-capita income
Sao Paulo.design_weight: Author calculated sampling expansion of source population
Sao Paulo.rights: IBGE attribution and provider terms apply to source fields; author CC BY 4.0 grant covers author calculations/classifications only

Bogota.lat/lon: GHS-POP R2023A projected E2025 30-arcsecond WGS84 cell centre
Bogota.pop: GHS-POP whole positive-cell population (projected population, not a census count)
Bogota.stratum/socioeconomic_group: Author mapping of source residential-block estrato; original polygons not included
Bogota.rights: GHSL/JRC CC BY 4.0 attribution applies to population/grid fields; local estrato retains source attribution/terms; author grant covers author calculations

mixed_derivative_files.source_fields: Bogota GHSL/JRC R2023A projected E2025 grid-centre coordinates/population and source ManzanaEstratificacion-derived estrato
mixed_derivative_files.author_fields: Computed socioeconomic group, mapped-area fraction, area-weighted estrato summary and sensitivity classifications; this file contains no route coverage outcome
mixed_derivative_files.terms: Same mixed-derivative rule; original estrato polygons excluded

estimation_inputs: data/estimation/times_primary.csv contains author-computed route minima/status and sampling design metadata with direct geographic identifiers removed. Source population fields: Sao Paulo IBGE CD2022 V0001; Bogota GHSL/JRC R2023A projected E2025. Source strata derive from IBGE income (SP) and Secretaria Distrital de Planeacion ManzanaEstratificacion (BO). No patient data; pseudonymous area records may be re-linkable via retained public area characteristics. Author CC BY covers author calculations only; source attribution/terms retained.
